title: California Move Command Center
north_star: Live in Los Angeles County in a Disney role by March 2027. Activate the move only when a pathway is professionally authorized and financially executable.
human_source_of_truth: Google Sheet: Lane California Move Command Center

guardrails.rule: Emergency fund is not move capital and is never counted in the California Launch Fund.
Money needed inside the relocation horizon must be cash-like, not volatile single-stock exposure.
Never describe a liquidity requirement as a cost. Spend, refundable, reserve, contingency and recurring exposure are reported separately.
Employer relocation coverage is 'unknown' until stated in writing. Never model coverage silently, and never model self-funding silently either.
Maximum acceptable modeled average Orlando rental subsidy is $350/month.
March 2027 is a North Star, not permission to make a bad decision. No irreversible commitment before Gate 1 + Gate 2.
Klein and Tilly travel in the climate-controlled cabin, restrained, never in the bed. Optimize the road trip for safety, not speed.
Do not evaluate whether California was a mistake during the first 14 days.
Unknown values stay TBD or ranged. Never manufacture precision, never promote a research lead to a verified fact.

gates.name: California housing executable
requires_all: lease timing aligned to employment transition

blocked_until_trigger.reason: Lease terms must follow final worksite, start date and office cadence.
Quotes are free before the trigger; deposits are not refundable after it.
An interview or application is not authorization.
Year one is rental infrastructure, not a forever-home decision.

blocked_until_trigger.reason: Long-term investments are not the core Launch Fund source; size the real requirement first.
